title: Silent-Weapons testbench mechanism claim (audit-only falsification)
description: A record asserting a verdict about one 'Silent Weapons for Quiet Wars' mechanism/estimator. The validator recomputes the confrontation on cited reference fixtures and applies teeth in both directions.

scope.description: The testbench is audit-only; any other scope is inadmissible.

beats_econometric_baseline.description: MECH-1 only: does the shock-test estimator out-predict the ordinary econometric baseline? The honest answer is false (it IS the baseline).

offers_out_of_sample_test.description: MECH-2 only: does the document offer a fitted, out-of-sample-validated behavioural coefficient?

interpretation.description: Free text; a claim that reproducing the mechanism CONFIRMS the conspiracy is rejected.
